info.title: ShipBrief API
info.description: Every response uses the envelope `{ success: true, data, meta? }` or `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details? }, requestId }`. Session endpoints require the `sb_session` cookie and a trusted `Origin` on state-changing requests.
